adjudication.finding: Both candidate-divergence moves are DEPLOYED in the canonical at parent strength; the committed-decolonial deployment is closed move-for-move.

coverage_map.genetic_move_naming: DEPLOYED — long (Dismantle) names it outright ('where a belief comes from says nothing about whether it is true') and shows it cuts BOTH ways (antinatalist pessimism has its own genealogy), which directly pre-empts the defender's framework-origin disqualifier. Present-compressed in medium ('cuts the same way').
coverage_map.standing_imperialism_question: DEPLOYED IN ALL THREE REGISTERS — self-applying anti-imposition ('the logic forbidding the imposition of a life forbids the imposition of a worldview ... The view is self-applying'), present even in the 557-ch short, essentially co-equal with the content move. The defender's LEAD charge ('you have no standing to apply this to us') is fully closed at parent strength; front-loading it is cosmetic re-sequencing of identical content, not divergence.
coverage_map.content_engagement_asymmetry_decoupling: DEPLOYED (all registers) — sufferer-appears-under-any-ontology / no-web-can-consent / 'the frame redescribes the act, it does not supply a consenter or dissolve the sufferer' / burden-is-to-license-not-redescribe.
coverage_map.concede_heavily_and_route_residual: DEPLOYED (medium + long) — the honest rival-axiology concession ('not a redescription but a rival axiology ... against that reading it ties rather than wins; portable across descriptions, not across every axiology') IS the larger concession the kickoff specified, and it routes the genuine ontological residue to its terminus in place. A defender slot re-making this concession re-deploys canon.
coverage_map.anti_strawman_guard: DEPLOYED — 'I will not answer by debunking'; reverence-is-a-fact-about-the-tradition; explicit refusal to call life-affirmation 'coping.' The care-flag's hardest constraint (never strawman the tradition as naive 'life is good') is already honored in-canon.

sole_genuinely_absent_candidate.move: The OFFENSIVE monolith / re-essentialization turning-the-tables: 'invoking indigenous-philosophy-values-life re-essentializes diverse traditions into a single life-affirming bloc and ventriloquizes them to defend natalism — itself the colonial flattening the objection charges.'
reasons: D2 — the diversity material is latent in the node's NOTE but deployed there DEFENSIVELY (disclaiming representational authority). Weaponizing it OFFENSIVELY against the interlocutor is a different speech act, arguably a NEW move absent from parent rather than a legitimate re-aim. A defender slot is re-aim-only; an absent move violates D2.

Care-flag hazard — this is the single move most apt to commit the node's signature error. The care-flag warns that letting dodge-naming 'slide into dismissing the cultural critique wholesale ... would itself be the colonial move the objection charges.' Charging a decolonial interlocutor with 're-essentializing your own peoples' is a high-wire move that easily reads as condescending/dismissive.

Payload partly already carried — the canonical MEDIUM dissolves the life-affirming-monolith framing implicitly by naming anti-birth currents WITHIN non-Western traditions (al-Ma'arri, the Cathars, strands of Jain and Buddhist thought): 'cross-cultural disagreement shows the question is hard.' The monolith's payload (the framing is false) is thus already partly in-canon.

adjudication.contrast_with_granted_defender_slots: Inverse of privileged-first-world. That slot was GRANTED and earned its keep because its sharp closers (standpoint-disqualifies-the-natalist-FIRST boomerang; premise-concession trap) were NOT already foregrounded in its canonical at defender strength — a genuine re-aim adding punch. indigenous-philosophy's canonical ALREADY foregrounds the genetic-naming and the self-applying anti-imposition cleanly (the latter in all three registers), so a defender re-aim is redundant. This is exactly why the triage rated it needs_variants FALSE while privileged-first-world was in the authoring set.
